description: Source code defining barcode classes for USPS-related barcodes (FIM and POSTNET), including validation, decomposition, size computation, and drawing methods.

classes.name: FIM
classes.description: Class representing Facing ID Marks barcode, encoding a single character (A-D) with options for quiet zones and size.

classes.name: POSTNET
classes.description: Class representing POSTNET barcode for encoding US ZIP codes, with validation, encoding, and drawing functionalities.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input value for the barcode, ensuring it meets the required format.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Converts the encoded data into a pattern string for rendering.

methods.name: computeSize
methods.description: Calculates the size (width, height) of the barcode based on its pattern.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the barcode pattern using rectangle primitives.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the validated ZIP code into a pattern string with checksum for POSTNET.
